FIRST ADDENDUM 
 to Agreement to Sell by and between 
 Deevar Developers (Private) Limited (referred to as “Developer” ) and [•] [Buyer/Buyers Names] (individually, or in the case of joint buyers and collectively referred to as “Buyer " ) 
 [Each a “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”] 
 This first a ddendum (“ First A ddendum ”) to the Agreement to Sell [ Agreement No. ] dated [•] [INSERT DATE], (“ Agreement to Sell ”) is made and entered into at Lahore on this [•], 202 _ (“ Effective Date ”). 
 WHEREAS 
 The Parties entered into the Agreement to Sell for the sale and purchase of a residential apartment bearing Unit No. [●] measuring [ ●] located at Zameen Opal, Plot No. 16 and 17, Land Breeze Society, Raiwind Road, Lahore (“ Purchased Unit ”); 
 The Developer had notified to the Buyer through a Letter of Intimation of Zameen Opal dated [•] [DATED] about the continued surge in prices of Component Materials which has prompted an adjustment in the Purchase Price to the extent of the Adjusted Amount under Clause 3.3 of the Agreement to Sell and the Buyer has acknowledged and agreed to such adjustment; 
 The construction of the Unit has been completed and the Completion Notice dated [●] (the “ Completion Notice ”) has been sent to the Buyer to take over possession of the Purchased Unit after clearing all outstanding I nstalment Payments with respect to the Purchase Price and any other payments due on possession under the Agreement to Sell ; 
 Pursuant to the above, to facilitate buyers who have multiple i nstalments remaining in the Payment Plan, t he Developer has offered to grant a conditional licence to occupy the Purchased Unit temporarily until such time as all remaining i nstalments, along with any other payments due under the Agreement to Sell, are paid in clear funds by the said B uyer, in accordance with the revised Payment Plan appended to this First Addendum ; and 
 The Buyer has accepted the aforementioned offer of the Developer and, accordingly, the Parties have agreed to revise, amend and supplement the Agreement to Sell as per the terms and conditions hereof. 
 NOW , THEREFORE, the P arties agree as follows: 
 The First A ddendum shall be effective from the Effective Date . 
 The Payment Plan specified in Attachment B of the Agreement is hereby revised and amended with the Payment Plan specified in Annexure A appended to this First A ddendum . For the avoidance of doubt, the Payment Plan in Attachment B shall have no force or effect as of the Effective Date. Any and all references to Attachment B in the Agreement shall be deemed to be a reference to Annexure A appended to this First A ddendum . 
 
 The Developer hereby grants to the Buyer a conditional and temporary license to occupy the Purchased Unit (the “ Licen s e ”) for the period of the remaining /outstanding i nstalments in the Payment Plan subject to the licensing terms and conditions stated in Annexure B to this First Addendum ( the “License Terms ” ) and payment of Service Charges Advance at the time of execution of this Addendum . 
 Under the License and during the l icen s e p eriod, the Buyer will have the right to sub- license the Pur chased Unit against a sublicensing fee, in accordance with the Licen se T erms . 
 The Buyer shall have the right to charge a sublicens ing fee against a sublicense in accordance with clause 4 above, at his own discretion . 
 The Buyer understands and acknowledges that the Licen se is a conditional permission to occupy the Purchased Unit and does not create or transfer any right s , title or interest in the Purchased Unit in favour of the Buyer or the sub-licen s ee except to the extent envisaged under the Licen s e Terms . 
 The grant and subsistence of the Licen s e is strictly subject to fulfillment of the Buyer’s obligations under the Agreement to Sell, particularly payment of all i nstalments. T he Developer shall be entitled to revoke the License in the event of default or failure on the part of the Buyer to fulfill her/his obligations under the Agreement to Sell . 
 U pon fulfillment of all obligations and payment of all i nstalments and payments due under the Agreement to Sell, including inter alia a mount due on possession and Adjusted Amount, by the Buyer, the Developer shall transfer all rights, title and interests in the Purchased Unit to the Buyer by way of issuance of an allotment l ette r . For the sake of clarity, it is stated that u pon issuance of the allotment letter the temporary license granted herein shall cease to exist. 
 The Buyer agrees to furnish the following pos t dated cheques in favour of the Developer , with unconditional right to encash them, as a promise to pay the Instalments as per the P ayment P lan: 
 Rs. [●] (Rupees ●in words] via cheque number [●], dated [●], drawn on Bank [●]. 
 Rs. [●] (Rupees ●in words] via cheque number [●], dated [●], drawn on Bank [●]. 
 Rs. [●] (Rupees ●in words] via cheque number [●], dated [●], drawn on Bank [●]. 
 The scanned copy of the postdated cheque issued under this clause is attached in the Annexure [●]. 
 I n the event any of the aforementioned cheques is dishonored for any reason whatsoever, the Developer shall have the right to initiate proceedings under the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860 and any other applicable laws against the Buyer , in addition to any other rights or remedies available to the Developer . 
 For the avoidance of doubt, notwithstanding anything contained herein or in the Agreement to Sell, the Buyer shall be liable for all risk and costs applicable to the Purchased Unit as and from the Completion Date (including loss of or damage to the Unit or any part thereof). 
 The Developer shall obtain and, to the extent possible, assign to the Buyer the benefit of any manufacturers’ warranties, in respect of any fixtures or fittings installed by or on behalf of the Developer in the Purchased Unit on and from the Completion Date . The Developer makes no independent representation or warranty as regards the fitness for use or quality of appliances, fittings or fixtures and has relied on the manufacturers'/suppliers' representations and warranties in this regard. The maintenance and/or replacement of all appliances in the Purchased Unit shall be covered by the warranties of respective manufacturers issued at the time of purchase of such appliances and the Developer shall have no liability thereof including any extension in the warranty periods of such warranties. 
 Except to the extent specified herein, any other obligations of the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell to be completed on or before the Completion Date are hereby extended until the License Period lapses or the License is revoked/terminated. 
 It is clarified that, as per Clause 5.4 of the Agreement to Sell, all risks, responsibilities and obligations associated with the Unit shall pass to the Buyer as and from the Completion Date, whereas rights in the Unit shall be transferred with actual possession, i.e. upon payment of all i nstalments and fulfilment of all obligations of the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell. 
 This First A ddendum shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement. 
 All other terms and provisions in the Agreement shall apply mutatis mutandis, and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any conflict, the provisions of the First A ddendum shall prevail, and any conflicting term (s) in the Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately. 
 All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement shall bear the same meaning in this First A ddendum , unless otherwise specified. 
 The First A ddendum may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall constitute one and the same addendum . 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this First Addendum , having fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses .
